title: Two Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
hints: Think about what value you need for each number.
A hash map can help you find the complement in one pass.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
prompt: Given an array where each element is the price of a stock on a given day, return the maximum profit you can achieve from one buy and one sell.
hints: Track the cheapest price seen so far.
At each step, compare the current profit against the best one.
